description: Home advantage for a 2DT sport is RAW GOALS -- the model is additive, there is no link to undo. Applying football's exp() to an additive parameter is the B5 bug. This bound is a gross-error guard only: exp() of a realistic ~1.5-goal handball edge is ~4.5 and stays inside it, so the exact check remains tests/testthat/test-extract-2dt-home-advantage-units.R.
